svg.title: evict-h2o
svg.desc: H2O on a toy 16-token decode with budget 6 (3 heavy hitters + 3 recent). Tokens 1, 4 and 9 collect the most accumulated attention and stay; every other token leaves the recent window and is evicted for good. Real setting: 20% budget split 10% + 10%; Llama-3-8B at 32K drops from 4 GiB to 0.8 GiB of KV.
